senses.gloss_en: epidemiology (branch of medicine dealing with transmission and control of disease in populations)
epigastric (of or relating to the epigastrium)
epigastrium (the upper middle region of the abdomen)
epiglottis (cartilaginous organ in the throat of terrestrial vertebrates)
epilogue (short speech at the end of a play)
epsilon (name of the Greek letter Ε, ε)
